caption: The drawing depicts a woman standing and facing forward, wearing a long-sleeved, floor-length brown dress. Over her shoulders is a light grey, triangular scarf or shawl that covers the upper chest and shoulders. She wears a grey head covering that fits closely around her head, with some hair visible at the front. Her shoes are black and mostly hidden by the dress. To the upper right of the woman, there is a line drawing showing the back view of the dress. Below this, there is a representation of a bonnet: the outside is yellow or tan, and the inside is blue; a long, light-colored ribbon or cloth is attached to the bonnet and draped beside it. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color. At the bottom right corner are the words "Paul Childers."
title: Shaker Costume
